name: Pret A Manger
covers: Food and drinks in GB Pret shops
tips: Oat milk: the guide marks oats as a gluten cereal, so choose another milk.
Branded products: the guide doesn't list them, so check the packet.
Check the label: the guide says recipes change and can differ shop to shop.
gaps: Pret doesn't call any item gluten free. This app lists items with no gluten cereal ticked.
A tick means a product contains an allergen. There's no column for 'may contain' or traces.
Branded products (packaged snacks and drinks made by other companies) aren't listed. Check the packet.
